opening.argument: The speaker announces a free $10 iTunes gift-card giveaway, with participation tied to subscribing, liking, and commenting on the video. Those are ordinary entry requirements for a creator-run promotion. The description also presents an external code, but explains that its use earns the creator points to put toward another giveaway. The available evidence does not show what the external destination asks of viewers, whether those points have monetary value, or whether any giveaway was fulfilled. On this record, the stated purpose remains a giveaway, and the code's described role does not establish a different outcome.
